ModMetaData.name: The Dog Knows
ModMetaData.author: Nahuel
ModMetaData.description:
Your dogs and cats sense what your colonists cannot see.
When a revenant, a sightstealer or any other hidden hostile comes close, a colony dog or cat stops what it is doing, freezes, and stares at an empty patch of ground. Its hackles go up, it growls low, and its head follows something that is not there. Select it and it says: "Staring at something you can't see."
It is a hint, not a reveal. The entity stays invisible: you cannot select it or target it, and nothing about vanilla detection changes. The animal can only face one of four directions, so you still have to work out where it is.
- Who senses: huskies, labradors, yorkshire terriers and cats (with Alpha Animals also skiphounds, ray hounds and phoenix owlcats). Dogs sense up to 11 cells away, cats up to 9. Walls block it. - What they sense: hostile pawns hidden by any invisibility hediff (revenants, sightstealers, enemy psycasters, modded invisibility). Your own invisible colonists do not count. - Asleep, downed, drafted, roped, starving, berserk, hauling or caravan animals do not react, and each animal has an hour of cooldown after a stare. - Light on performance: one scan every two seconds of game time, and the animals are only checked while something hidden is on the map. - The list of animals is a def (TheDogKnows.UnseenSenseDef) that other mods can extend or patch. - Settings: message when an animal starts staring, low growl.
Requires Anomaly and Harmony. Safe to add to an existing save.
